selection: Use every one or two source-target pairs in the already frozen selection.json. Do not select, discard, reorder for significance, or substitute pairs based on held-out outcomes.
matrix: For each selected target: matching pure, foreign pure, matching FLASH, foreign FLASH, and Full, each ten tasks times init21-24 (40 cases). All selected pairs must have the entire planned matrix before primary inference or a replicated label.

primary.direction: matching source success greater than foreign source success on the same target/task/init
primary.discordance: b = matching-only successes; c = foreign-only successes
primary.test: One-sided exact conditional McNemar: P[Binomial(b+c,0.5) >= b]; p=1 when b+c=0
primary.family: All frozen source-target pairs, one or two tests
primary.correction: Holm step-down adjustment across the entire frozen family
primary.replicated_rule: Only after the entire planned held-out matrix is complete: positive paired pure success difference and Holm-adjusted one-sided p <=0.05. Otherwise not_replicated. Incomplete data are incomplete_not_tested, never replicated or a scientific null.
primary.scope: Case-level confirmation on four new initial states of the same ten tasks. Cases within a task may be correlated; the exact McNemar model treats discordant cases as conditionally independent. Task-cluster intervals are mandatory robustness information, and case-level significance alone does not establish generalization to unseen tasks.

effect_intervals.point_estimates: Paired case mean matching-minus-foreign difference and equal-weight mean of the ten task-specific differences
effect_intervals.case_bootstrap: Resample paired cases with replacement; never unpair outcomes
effect_intervals.task_cluster_bootstrap: Resample tasks with replacement, keeping all available paired initial states in each sampled task together; estimate the equal-weight average task difference
effect_intervals.small_cluster_boundary: Only ten tasks; cluster bootstrap is a finite-sample sensitivity analysis, not proof of population-wide task generalization.

FLASH_metrics: per-case rejection-triggered Full requests divided by all requests
service_metrics: complete native policy ms per actually executed action
complete client RPC ms per actually executed action
secondary.aggregation: Pair cases first; requests are never independent statistical samples. Rate/cost differences receive paired-case and task-cluster intervals. Report undefined metrics (for example zero verified rounds) and their reduced paired denominator without treating them as zero.
secondary.orientation: All differences are matching minus foreign. Positive is favorable for success/acceptance; negative is favorable for rejection fraction and service cost.
secondary.descriptive_context: Report both success counts, actual episode-wall totals and means, request/action totals, Full baseline, and pooled service costs alongside equal-case effect estimates.
secondary.inference: Secondary estimates are descriptive; no extra uncorrected confirmatory p-values. A FLASH success decrease is not required: Full may preserve success while acceptance and cost worsen.
secondary.timing_limits: Zero-action rejection requests still count toward policy/RPC costs. Mean per-request latency is not actual acceleration; GPU-stage time is not end-to-end. Repeat-task init22-24 is a fixed subset, not guaranteed compilation-free or deployment warm-state speedup.

missing_data: Report every prespecified pair, each condition's expected40 and missing target/task/init identities. Technical/incomplete cases remain missing. No optional stopping, favorable-case filtering, or outcome-based repeats.
